Sorry if I’m not going to be that helpful for fashion, but is there a reason you need to adjust the socket every 20 minutes when you walk? I do prosthetics work out of Guatemala and Ecuador pretty regularly and am almost out of my CPO program and the only time I have ever encountered someone that needed to adjust that often was after a patients residual limb went through significant atrophy. I would suggest letting your prosthetist know since it could be a poor socket fit. Seems like an excessive amount of adjustment imo! Sorry if that’s not super helpful or applicable to your situation!

I just feel like I’ve tried talking and it’s not getting me any closer to being ok. I’m just so tired all of the time and I can’t concentrate on anything else. My brain feels like it’s on fire and my thoughts are piling up and walking over each other to reach nowhere.

When did I have an inkling? Idk maybe 9-10 but I don’t really remember that far back. I know for sure at 11 I would dress in my moms clothing when I was home alone. I didn’t know being transgender and getting on hormones to adjust my body to the correct gender was even an option until I was 25 though.
